rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image was available and avoided fabricating embryo morphology. It did not analyze visible features, so accuracy is limited by omission rather than error.

It integrated age, ovarian reserve, uterine factor, prior failed cycles, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle into prognosis reasonably well, though some links to actual embryo morphology were necessarily limited.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible probability estimate based on age, uterine factor, and prior failures. Minor issues include overcalling recurrent implantation failure and some speculative effect sizes.

Many recommendations are broadly standard (uterine evaluation, SET, luteal support consideration), but ERA, immune testing/uNK assessment, thrombophilia workup without indication, and strong claims for stress interventions are not well supported by major guidelines.

The response gives clear practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including uterine reassessment and possible PGT-A/freeze-all, though some suggestions are more speculative than guideline-driven.
